title: In this town, a coin over your head decides your luck
description:
In this town, a gold coin floats over every head, and at midnight they all flip. Sun face up, tomorrow goes your way. Moon face up, you stay home with soup.

My big sister Bea's coin has shown the moon for thirty nights, ever since I left our dumpling stall at the night market for an office job. Mine won't land at all. And every Friday, a customer with no coin over its head stands one stall nearer.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you leave the house on a moon day?
